chapters.title: Chapter 2401: W-WHAT DID YOU DO!?
paragraphs: "Anyways, for now.
Let’s work with your lot."
Nux turned towards the rest of the Infinities and they flinched, that made Nux grin.
"Scared?"
He chuckled.
"Do you need some time to have a cute little meet-up? I learned that you lot do it quite often."
His words were far more terrifying when a being who was once called the strongest Infinity was screaming in uncontrollable agony right behind him.
"PLEASE!! PLEASE END THIS!! I BEG YOU!!!"
He screamed, abandoning all his ’Infinity Pride’ and begging for release.
And Nux—
He waved his hand and took away his ability to speak.
"That was annoying."
He spoke, rubbing his ear.
Then, he looked back at the remaining Infinities and—
"So? What do you say? Do you wa—"
Before he could even complete, a small darkness that had secretly moved behind him turned into Ul’Thakar and—
"You are dead, you basta—"
Just as Ul’Thakar was about to attack, to behead him with his claws, Nux simply grabbed his arm.
Again, he shouldn’t have been able to grab it since Ul’Thakar didn’t exactly have a physical body either but he did it anyway.
Then, he pulled the Infinity ahead of him and—
"Did you really think the same trick would work again?"
He asked, he seemed offended.
"You should have taken the time I was giving you so generous—"
Before Nux could complete—
Orravyn’s relics moved, trying to protect Ul’Thakar but before they could do anything, they were destroyed without any clear cause.
"What...?"
Orravyn’s eyes widened in horror.
The Archive in his hand flipped a few pages over, as if he was trying to generate more relics but—
Fwoosh
The next instant—
The Archive caught fire and was burned out of existence.
Orravyn’s horror increased tenfold.
"W-WHAT DID YOU DO!?"
He screamed as trillions and trillions of years of his work were simply... burned away.
And Nux—
"What’s with that overly dramatic reaction?
It wasn’t even that strong, I’ve seen better ones. I’ll bestow you some if you are an obedient little good boy, how about it?"
Orravyn screamed in rage but then—
Nux appeared right in front of him and put a finger on his lip.
"Shhh~
Good boys don’t scream."
He hushed.
Then suddenly, a large scale appeared above his head, ready to ’punish’ him for Impossibilities.
But—
CRACK
The scale cracked.
Equarios widened his eyes.
The Scale was merely a representation, it wasn’t exactly created out of matter to be able to... break.
Nux, however, completely ignored Equarios’s shock, he just grabbed Orravyn by his head, then, he erased the concept of death for him too and—
He crushed his face.
His face burst into blood.
But Nux didn’t stop, he grabbed his Soul, pulled it out of his body and did the same thing he did with Zylarith.
"AAAAAGGGGHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!"
Orravyn screamed the same way.
Nux shook his head—
"You people really do need to work on your pain tolerance."
He commented, shocked by how easily they screamed. Then, he turned towards Seraphielle with a slightly more hopeful look on his face.
"You must be better at this, no?
You do this thing on a regular basis."
"How do you..."
Seraphielle’s eyes widened in horror.
She had frozen the moment she saw what Nux did to Zylarith because this was exactly how she tortured her own victims until they died of extreme agony.
But—
No being, not even the other Infinities, should know that.
Then how...
For now, however, it didn’t matter because—
Seraphielle knew what was coming and she—
"Aaaggghhhhhh!!!"
She screamed and... she ran.
For what it was worth, she was still the fastest being in the Universe, even beings with the Power of Space couldn’t keep up with her speed.
So if she ran, no one should be able to catch her.
But—
Just as she thought of it—
Nux appeared right behind her and grabbed her by her hair.
"Aaaaahh! AaaaaAAhhhhHHhh!!!"
She screamed even more loudly, trying to tear her hair away from her head. Nux on the other hand, pulled her towards him and the moment she came closer—
He grabbed her by her leg.
"NO! NO! PLEASE! LET ME GO! I WILL GIVE YOU ANYTHING!!"
She screamed, no, she begged, her face was covered with tears and snot and Nux—
"Disgusting as always huh..."
He scrunched his nose in disgust.
Seraphielle tried to kick him, he grabbed her other leg as well, then, once he erased the concept of death for her too—
TEAR
He tore her body into two pieces.
"AAAGGGGHHHHHH!!!"
Seraphielle screamed.
He then grabbed her Soul, pulled it out and put her in the same state as the other two.
"AAAAAAAGGGGGGGHHHHHHHHH!!"
Seraphielle screamed even more loudly.
Now, the only ones remaining were Ul’Thakar, who for some reason, Nux had left before and Equarios who looked at him with a horrified look on his face.
Nux glanced at them, noticed their expressions, and he chuckled—
"You should have taken the time I gave you.
Not that it would have changed anything.
Still would have given your lot a few extra minutes."
He shrugged.
The first one he went for was Equarios, who was trying to run away. He ripped his arms off and did the same to his Soul.
Then he glanced at Ul’Thakar.
And the Infinity of Darkness, his reaction was better than the others.
He didn’t try to run or escape, he could see it was impossible, neither did he try to scream or beg for mercy because—
Would he show mercy to the people who tried to kill him?
He wouldn’t even show it to those who didn’t try to kill him, so expecting it in return was hypocritical.
Instead—
He just looked at Nux and asked a simple question.
"How?"
Nux tilted his head, amused by his reaction.
"How what?"
"How did you get so strong? You shouldn’t even be alive, I erased your existence, I sensed its disappearance myself."
Nux laughed at that, then—
"Turns out you can do a lot once you are dead."
Ul’Thakar’s crimson eyes shined at that answer, Nux laughed, knowing exactly what he was thinking, and he shook his head.
"Don’t get your hopes up.
It won’t happen to you."
Nux’s eyes then shined brightly and—
"I’ll make sure you won’t die."
He spoke as he disappeared.
Ul’Thakar tried to fight one last time, but Nux was simply too fast, by the time he could react, Nux was already holding him by his throat. He pulled his Soul out of his eyes and—
"AAAAAAGGGGHHHHHHHHHH!!!"
Ul’Thakar screamed in agony as well.
And just like that—
The battle ended.
With the Souls of all five Infinities screaming in agony powerlessly, unable to even die.
Nux stared at the beautiful sight he had created with a smile.
Then—
"You really did come back."
The Seer commented, standing behind him.
"Your plan succeeded."
Nux chuckled, without turning back.
"What happened to me?"
She asked curiously.
As someone who knew everything about every being, asking this question definitely felt... strange.
Nux looked at her.
One look was more than enough for him to understand the truth.

This was not the Seer’s real body. Well, technically, the Seer didn’t exactly have a body, she was merely an amalgamation of conscious thoughts that were so strong that it gave her something similar to a Soul or a Physical Body.
But even then—
This wasn’t the Seer’s true self.
It was... merely her projection.
Her real self had always been in the Multiverse, this was the Seer in the form of an observer, a being who wasn’t supposed to interact with the Universe.
This was also the reason her memories weren’t aligned with the real Seer, she only knew what the real Seer knew before this exact moment.
So when she asked what happened to her—
Nux smiled and—
"You still haven’t told me what you want."
He answered.
"Is that so..."
The Seer nodded.
"Are you going to kill me too?"
She asked, purely out of curiosity because she hadn’t forgotten the hatred-filled eyes Nux had looked at her with before being erased.
"You are a mere projection of thoughts, how am I supposed to kill you even if I want to?"

The Seer merely smiled at that answer. She knew Nux was lying, she had seen him erase the very concept of death right in front of her eyes, erasing a mere amalgamation of thought was no longer something that would trouble him.
Even then, she did not mention it, instead—
"Then I shall leave when I have the chance to escape."
She excused herself and left.
Nux didn’t stop her either. He just looked at the five Infinities still screaming in agony, looking at him with tears and snot covering their faces, begging for release, even death.
Nux looked at them—
Then he looked at the space around them and—
With the Power of Anomaly and Space, he sealed the space, making sure no being in the Universe could ever come here to save them.

The Infinities were going to be trapped in here and scream in agony for Eternity to come, it was the same, if not worse form of torture they inflicted on an uncountable number of souls they had turned into Relics.
With that thought in his head, he nodded to himself and returned to his Universe where he was greeted by his wives.
"You won."
Felberta smiled.
"Have I ever lost?"
Nux chuckled.
"You haven’t."
The Eldraeth laughed.
The rest of the women laughed, Nux looked at them with strong, desireful eyes. Soon however, he frowned as he noticed the Seer hiding behind Allura and Aisha.
"Just give me a few more years."
He spoke, he had already delayed this enough, he didn’t wish to delay it any longer but—
"No."
Allura shook her head.
Nux frowned and then—
"She decided what she wanted."

The Succubus spoke with a knowing smile on her face. An expression that Nux instantly realized, it was the same expression Allura usually had when she had ’convinced’ another woman to do something she didn’t initially want.
What surprised him even more was that while he knew Allura was... quite the talker, he didn’t think that even the Seer...
Nux looked at Allura, then at the Seer. The Seer looked away, she could tell what he was thinking and for the first time in her impossibly long life, she felt... embarrassed.
Nux blinked at that, his eyes then fell on Allura again and he could practically see her begging him to ask the question.
So he did.
"What is it?"
The Seer looked at him, then at Allura, Skyla and Aisha, the three women nodded and—
"A complete body."
She demanded.
"Annddd?"
Aisha jumped in, as if signalling her to continue, the Seer hesitated.
"Go for it."
Skyla laughed and in the end—
"And the permission to live here in your Universe, with you."

chapters.title: Chapter 2402: The End.
paragraphs: "And the permission to live here in your Universe, with you."
The Seer spoke honestly and Nux looked at her with a surprised look on his face. The Seer looked away again, thinking that her demand was something he wasn’t expecting but—
"Where else did you think you were going to live?"
Nux asked with a confused look on his face.
The Seer blinked.
She was confused too.
"You are an entity of the Multiverse, you cannot live in any Universe that is connected to the Universe, not unless you are willing to erase your memories and start clean.
But with what you are right now—
Your memories are the only thing that keeps you... you.
If you erase them, you might as well erase your existence."
"I am not willing to erase my memories."
The Seer answered, she was very sure about it.
"Exactly."
Nux nodded.
"So the Universe that can support you and your memories is me.
Of course, you are allowed to live here however you want, rule over whatever world you desire except for Umbrasol, or even live a simple life where no one knows you—
But I would still rather you be with me."
"I-Is that so...?"
The Seer stuttered.
Was that... a confession?
She thought inwardly.
Was he... always this direct?
She couldn’t help but wonder, her head felt a little hazy.
"Of course, who else are you going to talk to if not for me?"
Nux shrugged, then he looked at her with his golden eyes shining possessively and—
"Everyone else would just bore you, so you might as well live with me."
"O-Okay."
The Seer nodded.
Nux nodded back.
Then, with a wave of his hand, a familiar weapon appeared in his hand.
Bloodedge.
The Seer’s expression changed, she instantly realized what Nux was trying to do. Nux looked at her, as if asking for permission and...
"No."
She shook her head.
"I need a fresh start.
Not as Avernyth or Vashti.
But as someone new."

Nux smiled at those words, then he nodded. Even then, he grabbed the Bloodedge and with the Power of Anomaly, he freed Avernyth’s Soul from it and sent it into his Universe’s reincarnation cycle, allowing her to live a new, normal life.
Then, he turned towards the Seer and waved his hand again—
The Power of Life and Creation gathered around him and he started creating... another Soul.
This was what the Seer wanted from the very beginning.
A new Soul.
A new body to... restart her life.
Then why not go toanyother Universe’s God to get one?
Because that wasn’t possible.
A Universe’s God would never understand her existence, even if he did, he would never be able to pull her ’True Self’ from the Multiverse into his own Universe to give her a new life.
Heck, she didn’t even know if Nux himself could do that.
She was just...hopinghe would considering he had done what shouldn’t be possible almost all his life.
That was her plan.
A simple gamble based entirely on Nux’s ability to do something no being should be able to.
And Nux—
He simply waved his hand, a new Soul appeared right in front of him, then he looked at the Seer and—
"Imprint your conscious thoughts into it."
He commanded.
The Seer nodded.
She slowly walked towards the Empty Soul, closed her eyes and touched her forehead with the Soul’s.
The next instant, a white, blinding light filled the entire Universe, blinding every being in existence for a moment.
Nux looked at the bright light and for a moment, he didn’t know what to say.
Conscious Thoughts.

That was what the Light depicted, that was how... vast the Seer’s conscious thoughts were. If it were any other being instead of her, even if it was an Infinity, the light would have merely covered a world because that was the limit of most beings’ conscious thoughts.
That was the difference between the Seer and most beings in the Multiverse.
Nux noted it in his head, then, as the light faded away, he looked at the Seer’s Soul. The Blank, Empty Space he created had already taken the Seer’s Form.

Nux waved his hand again and created a new body, this was comparatively simpler. The Seer then moved her Soul into that body, a body that was still Mortal and ridiculously weak, but to the Seer, it was the strongest gift she had had for the longest of time.
An actual body.
An actual body that could interact with the life around her.
Her body trembled because of how intense her emotions were, then, tears rolled down her cheeks, surprising even her.
"It’s a new body, you won’t have the same control over it."
Nux explained.
The Seer nodded, she understood that.
Nux nodded back.
Then he looked at his wives and—
"I have already upgraded our Universe’s Cultivation Bridge, it is now comparable to the Cultivation Bridge of the strongest of the Universes in existence.
Infinity is no longer just a drea—"
"Nux."
Before he could even complete, Eisheth interrupted. Nux looked at her and the Succubus’s eyes shined brightly—
"Do you really think that’s what we care about right now?"
She asked.
Nux looked at her, then he looked at others, he looked into their eyes, he sensed their intense hunger, their intense desire and—
His eyes burned.
With raw, possessive, intense desire so strong that it overwhelmed all the women.
"Come."
He commanded. The women felt their bodies tremble, the Seer, with her body, had it the worst, she tried to leave these people to their business but then Allura grabbed her hand and—
"Where do you think you are going?"
She didn’t know how to answer.
The worst part?
Because of how weak her body was, she couldn’t even free herself from Allura’s hold and that made the Succubus smile even wider.
"You are coming with us.
Let us show you the mostefficientway to cultivate."
Allura declared and then—
Nux moved them all into theirprivate chamberwhere the concept of time no longer existed.
Meaning they could do itall they wantedand no time would pass in reality.
One of the many benefits of being with a Multiversal Anomaly who even the Multiverse couldn’t properly define~

A new body to... restart her life.
Then why not go toanyother Universe’s God to get one?
Because that wasn’t possible.
A Universe’s God would never understand her existence, even if he did, he would never be able to pull her ’True Self’ from the Multiverse into his own Universe to give her a new life.
Heck, she didn’t even know if Nux himself could do that.
She was just...hopinghe would considering he had done what shouldn’t be possible almost all his life.
That was her plan.
A simple gamble based entirely on Nux’s ability to do something no being should be able to.
And Nux—
He simply waved his hand, a new Soul appeared right in front of him, then he looked at the Seer and—
"Imprint your conscious thoughts into it."
He commanded.
The Seer nodded.
She slowly walked towards the Empty Soul, closed her eyes and touched her forehead with the Soul’s.
The next instant, a white, blinding light filled the entire Universe, blinding every being in existence for a moment.
Nux looked at the bright light and for a moment, he didn’t know what to say.
Conscious Thoughts.
That was what the Light depicted, that was how... vast the Seer’s conscious thoughts were.
If it were any other being instead of her, even if it was an Infinity, the light would have merely covered a world because that was the limit of most beings’ conscious thoughts.
That was the difference between the Seer and most beings in the Multiverse.
Nux noted it in his head, then, as the light faded away, he looked at the Seer’s Soul.
The Blank, Empty Space he created had already taken the Seer’s Form.
Nux waved his hand again and created a new body, this was comparatively simpler.
The Seer then moved her Soul into that body, a body that was still Mortal and ridiculously weak, but to the Seer, it was the strongest gift she had had for the longest of time.
An actual body.
An actual body that could interact with the life around her.
Her body trembled because of how intense her emotions were, then, tears rolled down her cheeks, surprising even her.
"It’s a new body, you won’t have the same control over it."
Nux explained.
The Seer nodded, she understood that.
Nux nodded back.
Then he looked at his wives and—
"I have already upgraded our Universe’s Cultivation Bridge, it is now comparable to the Cultivation Bridge of the strongest of the Universes in existence.
Infinity is no longer just a drea—"
"Nux."
Before he could even complete, Eisheth interrupted.
Nux looked at her and the Succubus’s eyes shined brightly—
"Do you really think that’s what we care about right now?"
She asked.
Nux looked at her, then he looked at others, he looked into their eyes, he sensed their intense hunger, their intense desire and—
His eyes burned.
With raw, possessive, intense desire so strong that it overwhelmed all the women.
"Come."
He commanded.
The women felt their bodies tremble, the Seer, with her body, had it the worst, she tried to leave these people to their business but then Allura grabbed her hand and—
"Where do you think you are going?"
She didn’t know how to answer.
The worst part?
Because of how weak her body was, she couldn’t even free herself from Allura’s hold and that made the Succubus smile even wider.
"You are coming with us.
Let us show you the mostefficientway to cultivate."
Allura declared and then—
Nux moved them all into theirprivate chamberwhere the concept of time no longer existed.
Meaning they could do itall they wantedand no time would pass in reality.
One of the many benefits of being with a Multiversal Anomaly who even the Multiverse couldn’t properly define~

chapters.title: Chapter 2403: The Revival.
paragraphs: Three thousand years after the five Infinities were locked in a space, the Universe had... changed.

The Four Supreme Worlds still ruled the Universe, they still made and implemented the rules and the remaining consciousnesses of the Infinities, Lord Light, Son of Darkness, Balance Interpreter, and Eternity’s Archive Holder, took command.
No one knew where the Infinities were, not even their own consciousnesses, but the people in the Universe believed they were alive and waited for their return.
As for Azriel—
He was standing in front of a smooth, white, shining ball floating in the empty void. It looked calm, silent at first, but the longer one stared at it, the heavier it felt.
It was the Core of the Universe.
*Picture*
Azriel stared at it and suddenly—
BOOOOOOOOM
The pressure around him shot up.
Infinity.
Yes, Azriel Ruinous had broken through and become an Infinity.
The best part?
All other Infinities in the Universe were no longer here to stop him, if Azriel wanted, he now had the power to make the Universe submit to him.
But—
"You know I do not want it."
He spoke as he looked at how the Core had begun trembling the moment he released his Aura.
Bzzz
The Core buzzed, its trembling eased at those words.
"But you also know what I want."
Azriel communicated, the Core paused for a moment, as if it was thinking it through, then—
Bzzz
It buzzed again, as if nodding.
"So you will let me do it?"
Bzzz
The Core buzzed again.
Azriel slowly stepped towards it, the Core trembled, still a little nervous, but it didn’t exactly have any other choice but to trust him because Azriel could easily get what he wanted through force.
Azriel gently made a connection with the Universe’s Core and closed his eyes—
BZZZZ
The Universe’s Core buzzed, Azriel saw countless Souls move in his head and very quickly, his eyes fell on two particular Souls.
Souls he recognized the instant he saw them.
Then—
He pulled those two souls out.

The two of them had been washed clean many times, they had lived countless lives Azriel did not care about, he simply searched through all the lives the two of them had lived until he got what he wanted.
Ithania Ruinous.
Luminia Ruinous.
Azriel stared at the two souls, for a moment, the strongest being in the Universe could not move because the intense emotions he felt froze him.
His heart screamed, his mind began to remember every single thing he had buried deep inside to protect himself from the pain, but his body moved.
He raised his hand.
Bzzz
The Universe’s Core helped him, memories of all other lives were gently wiped away, then the memories that had already been erased returned.
Then—
The Power of Life and Creation moved and their bodies were formed. Azriel made them exactly like he remembered them to be.
He gave Ithania her long blue hair, pale, flawless skin, and beautiful crimson eyes. Luminia had black hair, fiery red eyes, and a curvy hourglass body that would make any man drool.
And as he looked at them for a while—
His thoughts were stuck.
It was them.
It really was them.
His wives.
The ones he had failed to protect.
They... really were right in front of him.
Azriel’s body trembled as he waited patiently and in about a minute—
Their eyelids trembled and... they slowly opened their eyes and looked around in confusion.

To Azriel, it had been hundreds of thousands of years, but to them, it was only a few moments ago when they were surrounded by enemies, forced to end their lives so that they weren’t captured and used against Azriel.
But—
They self-destructed, they made sure they self-destructed then... how were they alive?
Ithania looked at her own hands, Luminia touched her face, their confusion couldn’t be stronger.
"How am I..."
Luminia spoke. Ithania turned towards her and was surprised to see her.
"You too..."
The two women looked at each other, then, they sensed another presence beside them and the moment they turned towards him—
They froze.
Not just the two of them, but Azriel too.
He tried to speak, his lips moved, no words came out and—
The strongest being in the Universe... started crying.
"Azriel..."
Seeing his state, Ithania’s confusion broke and was instantly replaced with worry. She stepped forward, Luminia moved with her and Azriel—
In his emotionally vulnerable state, he only opened his arms and the instant he did—
The two women moved into his embrace and the moment he held them, his body trembled strongly and more tears rolled down his cheeks.
"You are back... you really are back..."
He spoke in a hoarse, unbelievably weakened voice.
"Back...?"
Luminia frowned.
Ithania on the other hand, was far quicker to connect the dots and—
"You fool..."
She whispered, burying her head into his chest.
"How long did you suffer alone?"
She asked.
At that question, Azriel closed his eyes, more tears streamed down his eyes and—
"Too long."
That was the only thing he could say.
Those words made Ithania cry as well. At this point, Luminia too, had connected the dots and tightened her hold around Azriel, angry at herself at the thought of what she put him through.

Of course, Azriel didn’t blame them, he didn’t even think about whathadhappened, he simply hugged the two women in his arms gently, while his heart that had been burdened with pain for years, finally eased for the first time in such a long time.
"Heeh? Looks like I came at the right time."
That’s when a voice came from behind.

Azriel’s eyes opened. Ithania and Luminia turned instantly, their weapons appearing in their hands in an instant as their eyes fell on the golden-eyed man, looking at them with a playful smile on his face.
"Nux."
Azriel called out with a solemn face. Ithania and Luminia frowned, they did not know that name.
Was it an enemy?
Or an ally?
They wondered in their heads.
Ithania, looking at Azriel’s expression, felt it was the former and Azriel’s next words only made her surer.
"You shouldn’t be here."
"Still as welcoming as ever, I see."

chapters.title: Chapter 2404: The Ruinous Family.
paragraphs: "You shouldn’t be here."
"Still as welcoming as ever, I see."
Nux commented with a deadpan look on his face.
Ithania however, wasn’t amused, she directly pointed her sword at him, Luminia, trusting her instincts, did the same.
Nux instantly raised his hand when they did that—
"I am not the enemy, Mothers-in-Law."
"Mothers-in-Law...?"
Ithania frowned, looking at Azriel.
Azriel looked at Nux with a hateful look on his face, but then, he just shook his head.
"He is Aeliana’s husband."
"What...?"
Luminia’s expression changed.
"Aeliana...?"
Ithania’s eyes widened.
How could she forget that name?
She was their daughter!
"Aeliana is here!?"

She asked, her crimson eyes shining in excitement. Luminia too, instantly dropped her weapon and tried to walk towards Nux, wanting to assess the man who would be spending the rest of his life with her daughter but—
Azriel held her hand, stopping her.
That made Luminia frown, she looked at Azriel, he now seemed angrier. He then looked at Nux and—
"I asked why you are here, Nux."
That made both Luminia and Ithania frown even more, Azriel didn’t seem particularly welcoming towards him.
Was there... something wrong between these two?
But then...
What about Aeliana...?
But then—
"You know the Universe does not like you."
Azriel spoke up.
And those words confused the two women even further.
The Universe...?
The very Universe doesn’t like their son-in-law...?
Why...?
"I had a feeling."
The son-in-law in question simply smiled and for some reason, the two of them felt their mouths twitching.
This son-in-law of theirs...
He seemed... a little annoying...?
They turned towards Azriel, he, however, seemed more used to him, so instead of feeling the same annoyance they were—
"You had a feeling...?"
He raised his eyebrow.
"The Universe hasn’t forgotten what you’ve done.
Leave before it senses you."
He ordered.
But Nux just smiled, then, he waved his hand and behind him, a vast Space opened and as Azriel looked into that Space, he saw it.
Worlds.
Fifty thousand of them, floating in the distance.
Azriel narrowed his eyes, Ithania and Luminia stared at the scene in front of them with horrified eyes.
What was this...?
Another Universe...?
They wondered in their heads.
And Nux—
"I brought a gift."
He smiled.
Then, he looked at the Universe’s Core behind him and—
"For the Universe."
"Fifty thousand High-Level Worlds.
This is far more than what I devoured.
I brought it as a Sign of Peace."
Luminia and Ithania already felt lost, Azriel on the other hand, didn’t know what he should say, he had heard the gist of it from Aeliana but...
To think this monster really had access to quindecillions of Universes now...
For a moment, Azriel pitied the Multiverse, but then he just shrugged and turned to the Universe’s Core, proposing Nux’s offer.
Bzzz
The Core trembled again, its Light grew colder when it was told the Anomaly was here. For a moment, it thought of attacking, Azriel sensed it and—
’Don’t bother.
He is far more monstrous than you know.
If you attack, he will erase us.’
He warned.
The Universe paused at that.
Then—
It considered the gift Nux had brought and—
Bzzz
It trembled again.
Azriel looked back at Nux and—
"Your trick worked.
The Universe will accept the gift."
"That’s goo—"
Before Nux could express his joy—
"But it has a condition."
Azriel interrupted.
"Of course it does."
Nux sighed.
"You will never devour from this Universe again."
"I promise."
Nux didn’t care.

He had countless Universes to devour from, having one less option didn’t matter. Azriel communicated that with the Universe, the Universe’s Core pulsed, its Cold Light disappeared, like it made peace.
Nux sensed that as well.
He looked at Azriel, who looked back, the two exchanged nods, then, with a wave of his hand, Nux gave the dimension he brought to Azriel, who gave it to the Universe and—
Bzzzzz
The Universe’s Core shined as it devoured the entire dimension, filling itself with abundant resources that it had been lacking for centuries now.
"It seems happy."
Azriel commented with a light smile.
"Well, who doesn’t like a few candies?"
Nux chuckled.
Then, just to test it, he released a bit of his Aura, an act that previously would have made the Universe come at him with everything it had.
But this time—
Even though the Universe’s Energy moved around him, instead of trying to rip him apart, it was more like a greeting.
"From enemies to allies, eh?"
Nux laughed.
The Core pulsed, as if it understood him like it understood Azriel.
Nux nodded, then, he opened a few more portals behind him and his entire family stepped out.
All his wives and his children rushed out with bright smiles on their faces as if they all were going on a field trip.
Just like others, Aeliana was excited too, it had been a while since she met her father, but the moment she came out with Samael—
She froze.
"Mother...?"
Samael called out with a confused look on his face.
Samael was still only eleven years old, yes, while three thousand years had passed here, only one had passed in Nux’s Universe, so his children were still... children.
"Mother, are you alright?"
Samael’s frown deepened, he looked in the direction his mother was staring at and his eyes fell on his grandfather and two unknown women standing beside him.
The two women looking at his mother were frozen as well.
Then—
The blue-haired woman called out—
"Aeliana...?"
She couldn’t believe it.
Her daughter was standing right in front of her, older, stronger, and much more beautiful than before.
Luminia covered her mouth in disbelief. She slowly walked towards Aeliana, as if afraid that if she moved too quickly, then all of this would disappear like an illusion.
But before she could even comprehend the situation—
Aeliana was already in her mothers’ arms.
The three women hugged each other with tears in their eyes, no words or introduction were needed, Luminia and Ithania could instantly sense their connection, so did Aeliana.
Azriel watched that sight from a distance and felt a... strong sense of fulfilment.
This was it.
This washisfamily.

The more... familiar she looked.

He asked directly.

Allura laughed.

"If I put the Blindfold on, would that help?"

"You are—"
"Ilyra."

Yes.

"You are only a Primordial."
Azriel narrowed his eyes.
He revived his wives as well, so he knew how it worked, both Luminia and Ithania were as strong as they were at their peak.

"I got a new body a year ago, Azriel."
She spoke.

She started as a Mortal and that...
"You are already a Primordial..."
He repeated.
Primordial in a year...
Even he wasn’t that fast.
"Well, we did put in quite a lot of work."
Nux grinned with a knowing look on his face.
Azriel’s mouth twitched in annoyance.
"How have you gotten more annoying than you already were?"
He couldn’t help but ask.
"I died.
That helps quite a bit."
Nux laughed.
"I have gotten more of everything ever since I returned."
Ithania and Luminia blinked at those words. They looked at Aeliana with frowns, wanting an explanation, Aeliana just sighed.
"Don’t ask."
"We missed too much, huh..."
Luminia lowered her head.
"Don’t worry, I’ll keep you updated, Mothers-in-Law. As it happens, I have a good memory, I will show you everything."

"Or most of it."
He corrected himself.
"Alright, that’s enough."
Azriel jumped in, glaring at Nux, who obediently stepped back and raised his hand, showing he was harmless.
Azriel sighed, then, he shook his head, he glanced at his wives, Nux’s wives, Nux’s children and then—
He thought of something.
"Yrniel."
The World where it all began.
The instant everyone heard that name, they reacted. Those who weren’t from there had heard the stories, the children looked excited too.
They wanted to go.
There were people there they wanted to meet.
"Now that you are the God of the Universe, you should be able to take us there even though the Universe’s Barrier is still hiding it, no?"
Nux mentioned it.
"I can."
Azriel smiled.
He could literally do anything in this Universe.
"I was waiting for it."
Nux smiled, seemingly excited to return.
Azriel, however, didn’t move. Instead, he stared at Nux for a moment and he narrowed his eyes.
"You could have gone there on your own."
He commented.
Nux just smiled and Azriel’s mouth twitched.
"You could have, couldn’t you?"
Nux did not answer.
But that in itself was an answer.
"You waited for me."
Azriel didn’t know how he was supposed to feel. Nux looked at him, then he looked at his Mothers-in-Law, then back at him—
"This is your Universe, Lord Azriel.
You should be the one making these decisions."
Azriel’s expression changed at those words. For a moment, the two beings just stared at each other, then—
"How strong are you now?"
Azriel asked out of the blue.
And the moment he did, the atmosphere shifted. Even Ithania and Luminia looked at Nux with interest.
They wanted to know.
They could feel their son-in-law wasn’t exactly simple, but still, they wanted a clearer explanation.
"Grandfather and Father should fight!"
That was when Zyrax proposed, his draconic eyes shining with excitement and the instant he did—
"Yes!"
"Fight!"
"I want to see as well!"

The children had heard time and time again how strong their grandfather was. They were told how their grandfather had weakened, but today, as they came here, they were told how their grandfather had recovered and had actually gotten stronger than he was before.
And that made them curious.
The grandfather who they had always heard was strong.
Or their father who they believed was the strongest no matter what.
They wanted to see them fight.
They wanted to see who was stronger with their own eyes.
Azriel sensed their excitement, he even sensed his wives’ curiosity, then he glanced at Nux.
For a brief moment, his old pride stirred.
He had just become the God of the Universe.
An Infinity.
The highest existence this Universe could accept.
A battle against Nux would not be simple.
But perhaps...
That was when Nux looked at him and shook his head.
Azriel frowned.
He could tell that wasn’t a request, it was... a statement.
’You will not win.’
And the worst part?
He couldn’t sense even a tinge of arrogance on Nux’s face, it was the plain truth.
Azriel looked at Aeliana and...
She shook her head the same way he did.
There was not a single trace of doubt on her face.
Nux would win.
By a margin.
And... Azriel blinked.
Ithania and Luminia noticed that exchange, they noticed Nux’s expression, they noticed Aeliana’s signal and...
They frowned.
Did the children not know... who Azriel was?
They couldn’t help but wonder.
They looked around and noticed the other Progenitors weren’t here either.
Was Azriel hiding his strength?
No, that wasn’t the case. They could see it from Azriel’s expression, he seemed taken aback as well.
So Ithania turned towards Aeliana and—
"It will be fin—"
She was about to calm her, to tell her that her father wouldn’t hurt Nux but before she could complete her words.
"I see."
Azriel spoke up, then he looked at the children and—
"We won’t be fighting."
He declared.
For the first time in his entire life, Azriel Ruinous backed down.
Luminia and Ithania were in disbelief.
"Come on!"
"Grandpa, are you backing away from a fight?"
The children cried.
"That is enough."
That was when Nux spoke up as well.
He looked at the children with a strict look on his face and—
"Grandpa isn’t backing down.
The Universe isn’t strong enough to contain our battle.
We cannot fight because if we do, the Universe will collapse."

chapters.title: Chapter 2407: You are hugging me?
paragraphs: "Grandpa isn’t backing down.
The Universe isn’t strong enough to contain our battle.
We cannot fight because if we do, the Universe will collapse."
Nux clarified.
The children looked at the two of them in awe.
Just the notion that even the Universe would collapse if their father and grandfather fought was mind-blowing, they wanted to become that strong as well.
Nux then looked at Azriel and nodded, Azriel nodded back.
"Now who wants to go to Yrniel?"
He asked.
The children quickly turned towards him with excited eyes. Azriel chuckled and with a wave of his hand,
Every person here moved to Yrniel.
Yrniel’s Will reacted.
It sensed the invaders and tried to alert the Progenitors but the instant it realized who one of the invaders was—
It stopped.
The anger turned into joy as light winds started blowing in their welcome.
"It has been a while, friend."
Azriel greeted with a smile.
"It’s still the same as before."
Ithania laughed, the winds were greeting her and Luminia more gently than they were greeting Azriel.
The children, the women, everyone laughed, enjoying the welcome.
"Seriously?"
Everyone but Nux.
Let alone wind, there wasn’t even air around him, it was as if Yrniel wanted him to die choking.
"Were you expecting a welcome? It was your actions that put its safety at risk, don’t think it wouldn’t know just because it could no longer sense you."
Azriel smiled.
"Whatever."
Nux just snorted.
Then, he looked at his wives and—
"Well? We are here.
I know how badly you wanted to leave so what are you waiting for?"
He laughed.
The women laughed too, then, they disappeared with excited eyes, even Sharnoth left because she was curious about the World Nux came from.

Ilyra stayed, she had already seen all of Yrniel, so she wasn’t particularly interested and because she had stayed, Amaya wanted to stay as well, but Orion wanted to explore Yrniel, so she had no choice but to leave as well, though she didn’t go before glaring at Ilyra one last time.
A few seconds later, Felberta, Skyla, Lane, Shadow and their children were standing in front of a grand estate with the name Exceedo Genesis printed on the top.
"That’s a nightmare of a name, who came up with that?"
Kaelion commented.
"Don’t say that, it’s impolite."
Mira scolded. Then she looked at the name and—
"No matter how bad a name is, it must mean something to those who came up with it."
Felberta, Skyla and Lane looked at each other, not knowing what to say. Shadow just chuckled, while she tried to nudge Nihyron towards the other children so he would talk to them.
On the other side of the estate, a being sensed their Aura, his eyes widened in surprise as he rushed out.
And the instant his eyes fell on Felberta—
He froze.
"Mother...?"
"Royce."
Felberta’s eyes softened.
Aurelios and Lysera looked at their half-brother with curious gazes. He wasn’t particularly strong, he was a Primordial, but far weaker than most Primordials they had met.
But it didn’t matter, he was still their brother who had his own circumstances, so they didn’t judge, instead, they greeted him respectfully.
Royce froze when he saw them.
He looked at Felberta, Felberta nodded with a smile and a big smile appeared on Royce’s face.
He quickly welcomed everyone in. Olivia, Royce’s wife, bowed and greeted them. Felberta greeted her with a smile as well.
Then, she met the rest of Royce’s family that had grown all these years.
It was a heart-warming moment, something that made Felberta’s heart ache and feel a sense of fulfilment at the same time.
While Felberta and others were with Royce—
Aisha, Eisheth, Allura and their children were in the Lust State that was now ruled by the Queen of all Succubi, Rislith Lust.
However, unlike Felberta and others, Aisha didn’t wait for someone to sense her, she directly barged into the Royal house, knowing exactly where her sister would be.
And just as she expected—
Rislith sat on the throne, busy with the State’s work.
"Thank the Lord I gave the throne to her."
Eisheth sighed, recalling how tiring all this work was.
"As if you did anything.
She was the one ruling your State for you."
Aisha rolled her eyes.
That was when Rislith turned towards them for a moment and—
"Stay there, I will come to you once I am—"
But before she could even complete her words, her eyes widened in shock as she realized who they were.
"Mother! Aisha! What are you doing here!?"
She asked in shock.
"Hmm? You seem busy, should we come later?"
Eisheth grinned.
"N-No! What are you talking about? Please come."
Rislith quickly excused a noble as she rushed towards them.
"Where’s the other one?"
Eisheth asked.
"I’ve called her. She should be here soo—"
"Mother! Aisha!"
Before Rislith could complete her words, Maline exclaimed as she rushed towards them.
The four Succubi hugged each other. Eisheth, Aisha and Allura then introduced their children, Rislith and Maline introduced theirs, which was a pleasant surprise.
The family gathered for a long, long talk.
Melia, along with Noctis, arrived at the Bloodheart House.
"Excited?"
Melia asked before she stepped in. There was a rare smile on her face today. Noctis looked at her, then at the smile on her face, and he smiled as well.
"I am."
"Let’s go."
She walked in.
Or...
She tried.
But the guards at the gates stopped her.
"Identify yourselves."
They spoke with solemn looks on their faces.
"...what?"
Melia blinked.
Soon however, the realization set in. Thousands of years had passed, of course no one here would recognize her.
"I am—"
"Let her in."

Rune and her daughter Sable were standing in front of Oberon and Felix Feline, both of them were staring at the two with shocked looks on their faces.

"Rune..."
Oberon walked forward slowly, his old body trembling.
"Father."
Rune greeted, her emerald eyes turned moist. In the end, she dashed towards him and jumped into his embrace while making sure she didn’t hurt him.
Felix looked at her, then at Sable and...
"I have many questions."
He spoke. Rune, still hugging her father, looked at him, then she wiped her eyes and—
"You always do."
She smiled.
Felix laughed gently as he picked Sable up in his arms, he could tell who the little thing was without Rune’s introduction.
"Hello~"
He greeted.
Rune smiled at that.
Felix then started introducing his own family.
"You seem nervous, Mother."
On the other side, Frostra noticed as they stood in front of the Elven Castle.
Lyriana didn’t say anything.
Was she nervous?
She was.
She had practically abandoned her daughter to go with Nux and now that she was here, she felt... complex.
She didn’t even know if it was a good idea to be here.
But—
While Lyriana was thinking about all that—
"Mother...?"
A voice was heard.
Lyriana turned and her eyes fell on a woman who seemed like her exact replica.
It was Ariana.
Lyriana’s eyes widened, Ariana was no different.
"It really is you!!"
Ariana exclaimed as she rushed towards her.
Lyriana flinched, not knowing how she was supposed to react, Frostra gently held her hand, nudging her forward.
Lyriana felt strange being supported by an eleven-year-old, but in the end, she stopped thinking about it altogether and just hugged her daughter who had already jumped into her embrace.
"I missed you!!"
Ariana spoke as she tightened her hug around her. Those words pierced through Lyriana’s heart—
"I am sorry for leaving you."
She spoke with moist eyes as she gently patted her daughter’s hair.
"No. You have nothing to be apologetic for."
"Mother, you chose yourself for once in your entire life, you deserved it."
Ariana spoke with a serious look on her face. Then, she smiled and—
"And look at you now, you now seem stronger than any being I’ve met, even Lady Vyriana that I knew wouldn’t be your match right now."
Ariana praised as she hugged her again.
Then, her eyes fell on Frostra, who was observing her silently and she blinked.
"Mother...? Is she...?"
She looked at Lyriana although she had already picked it up.
Lyriana nodded with a light smile—
"She’s your sister, Frostra Leander."
Ariana’s eyes brightened.
"Frostra..."
She repeated the name as she pulled her cheeks.
"Aahh!"
Frostra pouted and Ariana laughed.
"Wait a minute."
She looked at her mother with an excited look on her face and brought out a Call Artifact.
[What is it?]
A voice was heard.
Lyriana recognized it.
It was Elijah Sky, the Vampire Prince and Ariana’s husband.
"Come back."
Ariana ordered.
[I can’t. You know I a—]
"Boy, I told you to come back, so you better and bring Lyriana with you. There’s someone I want her to meet."
Lyriana raised her eyebrow at that, Ariana grinned at her and nodded.
[Who are you thinking of flexing your daughter in front of now?]
The Vampire Prince sighed.
"Just come quickly okay? Pleasee?"
[Alright, alright, I am coming.]
Elijah nodded and the call ended.
"Just wait."
Ariana looked at her mother and grinned.
"You will love her."
Lyriana didn’t know how to react.
Ariana then took Lyriana and Frostra to the Royal Mansion, showing everything to Frostra on her way.

Within a few hours, Elijah came with their daughter, Lyriana Frostwillow. Lyriana met her granddaughter and felt overwhelmed. Frostra and Lyriana, since they were nearly the same age, quickly became friends as well.
Other women who were simply moving around Yrniel together with their children were having a great time as well.
Yrniel was... definitely different than other worlds they had been to.
It was home to most of them, so it had a form of nostalgia to it, others simply found it amusing that this was where Nux and others from his family were from.
Yrniel’s blue sky, despite being much smaller than most worlds Nux had been through at this point, had... a strange sense of ease around it.
A place where he didn’t have to worry about anything.
A place where old family members, old friends, old names they had not heard for a long while could gather together.
Some of these people recognized Nux and were shocked by how different he felt, some did not even understand what he had become, some looked at his wives, some stared at his children.

Nux’s family saw a lot of new faces as well, Royce, Rislith, Maline, Lazarus, Felix, Ariana, they all had new family members in their families, many children were of the same age as Nux’s children, so new friends were made.
Questions came from every direction, tears fell, laughter followed, for once, no one was fighting, no one was dying, no Universe was collapsing.
Azriel stood a few meters away from the gathering, watching Samael talk with other children with... a complicated look on his face.
"Overwhelming isn’t it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2409: I did not take you for the romantic type.
paragraphs: "Overwhelming isn’t it?"
That was when Ithania and Luminia walked towards him and smiled.
"It is heart-warming."
Azriel smiled.
Ithania looked into his eyes and—
"You’ve created quite a strong wall around yourself."
Azriel looked at her and frowned, Ithania however, just looked at Aeliana and Samael and shook her head with a weak smile.
"I guess this is our fault for leaving you.
You were left with no one to talk to."
Luminia looked down as well.
Azriel looked at the two of them and—
"Yes, I feel overwhelmed."
He answered honestly.
The two women looked at him and he continued—
"I became the God of the Universe today, the supposedly strongest being in the Universe."
"The strongest being in the Universe huh..."
Luminia smiled.
She liked that title.
Soon, however, she frowned.
"Why does that make you feel overwhelmed?"
Ithania had the same question. As far as they knew Azriel, he would only nod at that title, thinking it was only obvious that he would become the strongest, not feel overwhelmed or burdened by it.
"Because I did not earn that title on my own."
"What...?"
The two women frowned.
Azriel then glanced at Nux who was dancing with his daughter Mira and—
"I wasn’t the one who defeated the enemies I was supposed to defeat."
"Enemies you weren’t supposed to defeat?"
Luminia frowned.
Ithania on the other hand, looked in the direction Azriel was looking at and...
"Azriel."
She called out.
"Why didn’t you fight him today when that child asked you?
Were you trying to give that boy some face in front of his children?"
That was what both Ithania and Luminia believed but...
"No."
Azriel shook his head.
The women frowned, Azriel looked at them and—
"He told me I would lose."
Ithania blinked.
"And you believed that?"
Luminia raised her eyebrow.
"Aeliana said the same thing."
Azriel explained himself.
"Azriel, she’s a child who’s in love with her husband, she isn’t the most ideal person to take an opinion fro—"
"She knows how strong I am."
Azriel interrupted her.
Then, he looked at Nux and—
"He does too.
I am the one who doesn’t know how strong he is."
The women’s frowns deepened. Azriel turned to them again and—
"What I do know is that he is the one who defeated the enemies I told you about—
In less than a minute.
And it took that long because he was playing with them."
Azriel’s face then turned even more solemn and he spoke honestly.
"And even at the level I am today, let alone in less than a minute, I am not certain I can defeat all five of them at all."
And the moment they heard those words, the women widened their eyes in disbelief.
"So... it wasn’t you saving his face...
It was... him saving yours?"
Luminia muttered.
"Yes."
Azriel answered honestly.
"You... actively backed away from a fight...?"
Luminia asked and this time—
Azriel did not say anything but the silence alone was enough of an answer.
The two women looked at their son-in-law with horrified looks on their faces.
Just...
Just what sort of monster had their daughter married?
And as if he sensed their gazes, Nux stopped for a slight second, turned towards them, then he grinned and bowed respectfully, greeting his Mothers-in-Law.
And Luminia and Ithania...
They could only smile back until finally, Aeliana pulled them into the gathering, leaving Azriel alone.
Azriel frowned at that, usually Aeliana would bring him as well, then why...
"Father-in-Law."
That was when he heard a voice from behind him. His eyes widened in shock, he looked back and saw Nux standing right behind him.
He was just there...
When did he... get here?
He didn’t sense him at all.
"So that’s why..."
He muttered out loud.
"Hmm?"
Nux tilted his head.
"Nothing."
Azriel shook his head.
"Why are you here?"
"I’d like to show you something."
"What?"
He asked.
Nux touched Azriel’s back and before Azriel could understand what was happening or react to it, Nux moved him into an unknown space even the Universe couldn’t sense and—
"AAAAAAGGGGGGGGGHHHHHHHHH!!!"
They were greeted with gut-wrenching screams.
Azriel looked at the beings screaming and his eyes widened.
"They are..."
"Yep, the Infinities."
Azriel looked at Nux, horrified.
"They have been... like this?"
He asked.
Nux just shrugged.
"I left them for you.
You can do to them what you see fit."
"Why leave them to me?"
Azriel frowned.
"I thought they might be useful to you."
"They would be useful to you too."
Azriel knew because he knew Nux had the monstrous ability of devouring other beings’ Laws.
But—
"They are not."
Nux just shrugged.
"What...?"
Azriel blinked.
"They are useless to me."
Nux repeated.
And Azriel...
He didn’t know what to say.
"How strong have you become, really?"
Nux didn’t answer that, so Azriel changed the question.
"If you and I fight, who would win?"
"I told you that before."
Nux looked at Azriel.
"I still need an answer."
"I will win."
"How sure are you?"
Azriel asked.
"If that’s your way of asking what your chances of defeating me are—
They are zero."
"I am the Universe’s God, Nux."
Azriel felt like he was being underestimated.
But Nux just shook his head.
"It won’t matter if I simply destroy the Universe you rule."
"What...?"
Azriel blinked.
"I have destroyed seven Universes so far, Father-in-Law.
And I have killed three Universe’s Gods who were far more experienced than you are right now."
Azriel looked at Nux for a long time.
He searched for pride, for exaggeration, for playfulness.
He did not find it.
Nux was not trying to flaunt, he was not trying to humiliate him.
He was simply stating a fact.
And Azriel—
"I see.
You have finally achieved your goal, huh."
He commented with a light smile.
Nux looked at him.
Azriel was a man who had seen him live his own life hundreds of times inside the illusion, he knew what his mindset was, he knew what his ultimate goal was.
To become strong enough so no being could threaten him or his wives’ safety.
And—
And he had achieved that goal.
"Yes, I have."
Nux smiled back.
Azriel nodded, then he looked at the Five Infinities screaming in front of him and—
"I don’t need them either."
"Are you sure? I left them here for your sake."
Azriel looked at them, still screaming in agony, almost begging to be released.
"Can’t you hold them here for a bit longer? Or is there a limit to your power?"
Azriel questioned with a provocative look on his face.
And that made Nux smile.
"You can keep them here as long as you want."
"Good."
Azriel nodded.
"I don’t need them, at least not right now.
I currently have... more important things to do."
Azriel spoke with a calm, genuine, almost hypnotic smile on his face. A smile Nux had never seen before, even when Azriel was with Aeliana.
"Look at you~"
Nux grinned.
"So eager to return to Mothers-in-Law~
I did not take you for the romantic type, my dear Father-in-Law."
He tried to tease, Azriel however, only glared at him and Nux raised his hand in defeat.
"Alright alright, let’s go back."
Then, he brought Azriel back and the two joined the feast.

"He told me I would lose."
Ithania blinked.
"And you believed that?"
Luminia raised her eyebrow.
"Aeliana said the same thing."
Azriel explained himself.
"Azriel, she’s a child who’s in love with her husband, she isn’t the most ideal person to take an opinion fro—"
"She knows how strong I am."
Azriel interrupted her.
Then, he looked at Nux and—
"He does too.
I am the one who doesn’t know how strong he is."
The women’s frowns deepened.
Azriel turned to them again and—
"What I do know is that he is the one who defeated the enemies I told you about—
In less than a minute.
And it took that long because he was playing with them."
Azriel’s face then turned even more solemn and he spoke honestly.
"And even at the level I am today, let alone in less than a minute, I am not certain I can defeat all five of them at all."

"Yes."
Azriel answered honestly.

Just what sort of monster had their daughter married?

But—

Nux just shrugged.
"What...?"
Azriel blinked.
"They are useless to me."
Nux repeated.
And Azriel...

"I told you that before."
Nux looked at Azriel.
"I still need an answer."
"I will win."
"How sure are you?"
Azriel asked.
"If that’s your way of asking what your chances of defeating me are—
They are zero."

But Nux just shook his head.
"It won’t matter if I simply destroy the Universe you rule."
"What...?"
Azriel blinked.

He did not find it.

He was simply stating a fact.
And Azriel—

And—
And he had achieved that goal.

Nux smiled back.
Azriel nodded, then he looked at the Five Infinities screaming in front of him and—
"I don’t need them either."
"Are you sure?

Azriel looked at them, still screaming in agony, almost begging to be released.
"Can’t you hold them here for a bit longer?
Or is there a limit to your power?"
Azriel questioned with a provocative look on his face.
And that made Nux smile.
"You can keep them here as long as you want."
"Good."
Azriel nodded.
"I don’t need them, at least not right now.
I currently have... more important things to do."
Azriel spoke with a calm, genuine, almost hypnotic smile on his face.

"Look at you~"
Nux grinned.
"So eager to return to Mothers-in-Law~

He tried to tease, Azriel however, only glared at him and Nux raised his hand in defeat.
"Alright alright, let’s go back."
Then, he brought Azriel back and the two joined the feast.

paragraphs: As the feast continued and everyone celebrated, Ilyra distanced herself from the group. Then suddenly, she paused.
"Why are you following me?"
She questioned without turning around.
"I am sneaking around. Hehe~"
The little girl giggled.
Ilyra turned around and laughed out loud as she picked her up in her arms.
"It’s not sneaking around if you aren’t hiding yourself, Mira."
"What’s the point? It’s not like I can hide from you."
Mira shrugged as she let herself be picked up and Ilyra laughed again as she looked at her.
Mira was naturally curious, so when Ilyra arrived and Skyla told her how she knew everything there was to know about the Multiverse, Mira quickly became close to Ilyra and began following her around.
Other children were still a little wary around Ilyra since she was new, but Mira didn’t care.
She went ahead and made friends, something Ilyra gratefully accepted, the Omniscient woman actually liked being around Mira.
"That is true as well."
Ilyra smiled.
"Why aren’t you playing with your siblings?"
She asked.
"Because I saw you come here alone."
"Hmm?"
"You seemed lonely, so I came here."
"Aww~ Don’t make me love you more than I already do."
"Hehe~"
Mira giggled.
Ilyra smiled as she ruffled her hair, then suddenly—
"She didn’t come here because she was lonely, Mira."
Another voice was heard.
A voice Mira instantly recognised.
"Father!"
She instantly freed herself from Ilyra’s hands and jumped into Nux’s. The sight made Ilyra look at Nux with jealousy for a moment, but she quickly hid it.
Nux looked at her, then he smiled and looked back at his daughter, who had now made herself comfortable in his arm.
"Then why did Mother Ilyra come here?"
Mira questioned curiously as she looked at Nux, then at Ilyra, then back at Nux.
Nux smiled at that question as he looked at Ilyra and—
"She is looking at the Multiverse."
"Again?"
Mira frowned.
"Well...
The Multiverse has become... interesting."
Nux chuckled.
"And whose fault do you think that is?"
Ilyra spoke with a deadpan look on her face.
Because of Nux’s actions, the Multiverse was a mess, because of Nux’s actions, some Universes were now... wrong.
"I tried to limit the damage, okay?"
Nux tried to defend himself.
And he wasn’t wrong.

He did try to limit the damage, he only devoured a few Worlds from every Universe, and when he devoured the worlds, he didn’t leave all the Souls alone, making them all return to their respective Universes but...
That wasn’t nearly enough.
Because Nux’s actions had far worse consequences than one could imagine.

In the Multiverse, past, present and future weren’t separate, they all existed together inside a single branch and Nux ruined the cause and effect of these branches, ruining the causal foundation of countless Universes.
Basically—
A Universe exists because, somewhere in its parent Universe, a Time event happened that created its Branch.
Now inside the Parent Universe’s Timeline, that event may happen ’in the future.’
But for the Multiverse—
Both things already exist.
The parent Universe.
The future Time event.
The Branch born from it.
And the new Universe that grew from that Branch.

So when Nux entered a Universe at some point in Time and devoured a world, he messed with its timeline, which caused the Time Event that gave birth to a Child Universe in the Future to never happen in the first place.
So his actions basically ended another Universe’s beginning.
But...
That wasn’t it.
He didn’t just stop that Universe from being born, because in the Multiverse, that Universealready exists.
What he did was much worse.
He removed the Universe’s reason for being born, creating a Universe with no valid Origin, a Universe whose Branch exists, but whose branching event no longer does.
A living contradiction.
A...Rootless Universe.
The worst part?

The Multiverse couldn’t just erase these Rootless Universes to solve the problem. After all, these Universes weren’t isolated mistakes that could be corrected, these were fully fledged Universes that had produced their own branches, their own Universes, and those Universes had produced even more Universes.
And after countless layers, one Rootless Universe may now supporttrillions of trillions of descendant Universes.
Even the Multiverse couldn’t remove that many Universes, just because their parent Universe no longer had a foundation.
The Multiverse was trapped.
It could not accept the Rootless Universe as normal since its very cause was erased, it could not erase it either.
"You know that wasn’t enough."
Ilyra spoke with a solemn look on her face.
Nux could only nod.
Yes, his ’measures’ weren’t enough.
"The Multiverse is a mess because of you."
Nux stared at the damaged branches of the Multiverse and—
"That is unfortunate."
He nodded.
"Unfortunate?
Just unfortunate?"
Ilyra looked at him with a frown. Nux looked back and shook his head.
"There is nothing I can do or say about it, Ilyra.
I did what I had to do to survive.
I will not deny, I did indulge because I craved power but even if I had not, the Multiverse would still be facing the same problem."
"That... is quite a casual remark."
Ilyra pointed out and Nux...
"I know."
He just agreed.
"You do know what is going to happen now, correct?"
She asked.
And Nux—
He looked back into the Sky, into the Multiverse and—
"I do."
He nodded.
The Multiverse could not erase the wounds from Nux’s attack, so it... tried to repair them.
It tried to create new causes, shifting some events here and there, small moments that would eventually lead to the desired future.
Of course, it wasn’t a perfect solution, it was only the beginning and the Multiverse was still moving, still looking for more solutions.

Where one cause was not enough, the Multiverse spread the burden, thousands of small events, millions of tiny changes, countless... weak reasons were gathered together to support one impossible existence.
The result was... ugly to say the least.
But it was the only thing that was possible.
And then—
Then came the most dangerous repair.
Even after the Multiverse’s countless, desperate attempts, there were some contradictions that... could not be corrected.
It erased those it could, those which wouldn’t do too much damage but for those that couldn’t be erased either—
The Multiverse allowed them to exist.
And because of that—
Things that should not have happened, happened.

Lives that did not fit their worlds began to appear, Laws formed in places where they had no reason to form, some worlds developed powers too early, some civilisations found paths they should never have discovered, some beings carried a strange pressure around them, as if reality itself was unsure whether to reject them or watch them.
"Anomalies."
Nux muttered as he looked at these contradictions.
Things that should not exist, now, they did exist.
"They are not exactly true Anomalies yet."
Ilyra corrected.
"Well, they are still... Possible Anomalies."
Nux smiled.
Of course, these were not True Anomalies.

With how the Multiverse worked, it would make it so most of them die before they understood what they were, some entities would lose themselves, some would be corrected by the very Universes that gave birth to them.
A mistake in reality, a broken birth or a strange fate was not enough, to become an Anomaly, one needed more—
Will.
Discipline.
Pain.
Obsession.
The refusal to kneel.
The madness to continue even when existence itself tries to remove them.
"A possible anomaly is born when reality makes a mistake.
A true Anomaly is born when that mistake refuses to be corrected."
Nux grinned as he looked at the Multiverse, at the mess it had become.
"Yes."
Ilyra nodded.
For a while, neither of them spoke.
The damaged branches continued to tremble before them, the Multiverse continued to repair itself. Both Nux and Ilyra continued to watch it quietly.
Mira tilted her head, watching the two curiously.
Then suddenly—
"Have you been looking?"
Nux questioned out loud.
"I have."
Ilyra nodded.
"It scares you that much, huh?"
Ilyra looked at Nux and spoke with an obvious look on her face.
"These are beings who might rival you in the future, Nux.
Yes, it scares me that much."
Nux however, only laughed at those words.
"They were born because I made it possible.
I doubt they would—"
Nux however, did not complete that sentence because... even he knew that wasn’t right.
After all, even his own existence didn’t just happen because of his hard work, it was a strange combination of strange occurrences, luck and more than a few coincidences.
"Does anyone in particular stand out?"
He questioned curiously.
"A few do."
Ilyra nodded.
"Who?"
Nux questioned curiously.
Ilyra pointed at a particular branch, at a particular world in that branch.
Nux looked.
"I want to watch too!!"
Mira exclaimed.
Nux laughed at that, then, he created a screen to share his vision and in that screen, a world appeared.
It was a modern world, tall buildings, cars, it was somewhat similar to Nux’s original world, but this one had... hidden supernatural forces moving under ordinary life.
Nux narrowed his eyes and the screen zoomed in, inside a Training Hall where a young man with black hair and strange violet eyes was standing in front of a woman.
His body was tense, deeply exhausted and didn’t seem like it was under his complete control, he was... only keeping it together through his sheer will.
Nux looked at the young man, then he looked at Ilyra—
"Him?"
"Look at his past."
Nux nodded.
Then he looked at his past, at his persistent self, at a body that couldn’t grow no matter what he did.
That made Nux frown, he looked into it and then—
He realised the issue.
Or...
Was it a blessing?
"He is fortunate."
Nux grinned.
"I wouldn’t call it fortunate."
Ilyra shook her head.
"Well..."
Nux didn’t know what to say.
He looked at the boy again, this time, he looked at his future.
He couldn’t watch it.
The boy was a Possible Anomaly, his Future had countless branches, watching it all was pointless.
But...
As he looked at the boy, as he looked at his past, as he looked at how he trained while fighting an entirely different battle in his mind—
"It would be interesting to see what he becomes."
Nux grinned.
"It will be!!"
Mira raised her hand as well.
But Nux—
He placed his hand on her eyes.
"No, you won’t be watching."
"What!? Why!?"
Mira questioned back but Nux...
He didn’t say anything.
What could he even say? That he would never want to be in the same position Lord Azriel was in when he dealt with him?
"You won’t because I said you won’t.
That’s it."
Nux spoke with a strict look on his face and then—
The screen in front of him disappeared.
"Alright, let’s go back and enjoy the feast."
—The End—
